positions.title: Automation Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Build an automation system to validate all Messages code changes
• Contribute to Message feature design, building automation in parallel as new features are built
• Create new automation infrastructure and frameworks
• Analyze and improve existing automation infrastructure
• Build and monitor result-reporting systems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities
◦ Analyze user requirements and collaborate on a best design approach 
◦ Utilize agile methodologies to iterate on a product until it meets user expectations 
◦ Generate test data to be used in efforts by testing team
 Projects
◦ Develop a program to re-assemble database table relationships that were lost and clone data while 
maintaining data integrity for performance testing 
◦ Implement extremely large file compare with performance less than ten minutes and present 
results in an end user friendly format 
◦ Design macro to generate test case templates from HP ALM test cases 
 Tools/APIs/Languages
◦ Spring Boot, Java, VB, MySQL, SQL, JavaScript, HTML, Maven, JS

positions.title: Software Developer in Test
positions.description:
- Develop maintainable, extensible, and reusable software modules
- Utilize JUnit to design robust automated unit tests
- Create, maintain, and execute test plans and test cases against software platforms
- Track defect severity, status, and estimated resolution time
- Write specialized testing tools for use in testing efforts
- Tools/APIs/Languages: Java, HP ALM, SQL

positions.title: BIM Modeler
positions.description:
- Develop internal excel macro for use in consolidating time sheets for submission to accounting database
- Draft shop drawings from redlines, plans, BIM models, etc.
- Coordinated with internal and external design teams to complete projects
- Utilize Autodesk Navisworks to perform clash detection and resolve issues
- Create Revit families as needed including completely custom trapeze hanger
- Interpret contract drawings into 3D BIM model
- Ensure architectural design standards are adhered to when producing shop drawings
- Route power feeders and branch circuits in accordance with BIM coordination efforts

positions.title: Electrical Apprentice
positions.description:
- Assist journeymen in troubleshooting issues
- Install electrical systems in accordance with NEC guidelines
- Utilize critical thinking to discover the most efficient approach to installation
- Read and understand blueprints and schematics
- Working knowledge of a wide array of tools

positions.title: Independent Software Developer
positions.description:
- Develop Android application to assist students with dysgraphia in organizing their work
- Generate project design documents
- Implement projects in accordance with project requirements and design requirements
- Perform debugging and bug fixes as needed
- Tools/APIs/Languages: Java, Android 4.2, Eclipse ADT, XML

positions.title: Production Associate
positions.description:
- Customized software modules to provide customers with real-time information concerning their fleet to better assist in making economic decisions
- Performed quality control and uploaded firmware per customer's specification
- Tools/APIs/Languages: Java, HTML, CSS
